earth.role: continuous warm road and bank mineral ground; no photographic noise collage

masonry.role: one stone scale across wall plinth, abutment, drainage; not isolated white boulders

timber.role: common structural timber in bridge and gate; visible support topology

tile.role: quiet slate roof mass, subordinate to gateway silhouette

foliage.role: one broadleaf family, layered crown interior; no bright toy globes

water.role: continuous negative space, not a prop-filled trench

foreground frame outside action lane; common authored broadleaf structure
continuous middle-distance ridge forest, not isolated conifers
whole slope and understory connected to bank shelves
